status.title: An experimental demo
status.body:
Director is an experimental demo built for a hackathon, offered free of charge to show what it can do. It is not a finished or supported product. In particular:

  • It may contain bugs, and what it says, plans, scores or makes may be wrong.
  • It may lose or delete your account, data and footage at any time, for any reason.
  • It may change, stop working, or shut down at any time, without notice.
  • There is no service level, support or availability of any kind.

You use Director entirely at your own risk. Don't upload or film anything you can't afford to lose or don't want processed as the privacy policy describes.

using.title: Using Director
using.body: By creating an account or using Director, you agree to these terms. You must be at least 13, and old enough where you live to agree to them yourself, or have a parent's or guardian's permission. If you use Director for an organisation, you agree to them for it too.

account.title: Your account
account.body:
Give accurate details when you sign up and keep your sign-in safe: you're responsible for what's done with your account. If you think someone else has got into it, you can tell us at manasmadan08@gmail.com.

Demo guests and the shared demo account are for trying Director only. They're deleted after a day, and everyone who uses the shared account can see what's filmed in it.

rules.title: What you may not do
rules.body:
Don't use Director to:

  • film or record anyone without their permission, or anywhere recording isn't allowed;
  • make, upload or post anything illegal, any sexual content involving someone under 18, harassment, threats or hate, or content that encourages violence or self-harm;
  • infringe anyone's copyright, trademark, privacy or other rights;
  • make misleading content of a real person, such as making it look as if they said or did something they didn't;
  • break YouTube's rules when you post;
  • get around Director's limits, such as the AI allowance, the one Short each account may index, rate limits or the sign-in check, for example by making many accounts;
  • break into, overload, scrape or disrupt Director, or any account that isn't yours.

content.title: Your content
content.body:
What you film, say, write and upload, and the videos you make with it, are yours ("your content"). You keep ownership of it.

So that Director can work, you give us a licence to store, copy, process, adapt and show your content, and to pass it to the services listed in the privacy policy, to run Director for you: to direct your shoot, cut and review your takes, edit your video, and post it to YouTube when you ask. The licence is worldwide and free, and it ends when your content is deleted, apart from copies that remain for a while in backups.

You're responsible for your content. You confirm that you have the rights to everything in it, including the permission of everyone who appears in it or whose voice it records, and of the owners of any music, pictures or other material you add. Keep your own copy of anything that matters to you: Director may lose it.

templates.title: Other people's Shorts as templates
templates.body:
Director's templates are YouTube Shorts made by other creators. Director plays them in YouTube's own player and has Gemini study them, so it can suggest shots. That gives you no rights in the original: its video, sound, words and style belong to its creator.

Your video should be your own take on the idea, made with your own footage. If you film to the original's sound or reuse its words, music or other parts of it, you may need its owner's permission, and getting it is up to you. When you post, Director adds a credit to the original creator and a link to the original Short to your video's description: please keep them. Stock photos come with credits that Director adds too, and their providers' licences apply.

ai.title: AI and its limits
ai.body:
Director is powered by Google's Gemini models. Its plans, directions, reviews, scores, transcripts, captions, pictures, clips and the posts it drafts are made by AI. They can be wrong, incomplete or not right for you, and Director can misunderstand what it sees and hears. Check them before you rely on them or post them: you decide what you film and publish. Director's suggestions aren't professional advice, so stay safe and aware of your surroundings while you film.

If your video uses a clip Director made with Google's Veo, Director tells YouTube that it contains altered or synthetic content when you post it, and YouTube labels it. Any other disclosure YouTube asks of you is up to you.

Director has limits so it can run on its budget, such as a monthly AI allowance per account, one Short of your own to index, at most 20 minutes of recording per shoot, at most 30 minutes per call with Director, and a daily limit on how many videos Director posts. They may change at any time.

youtube.body: Director posts only when you tap to post, to your own YouTube channel, with the permission you give through Google. By posting you agree to YouTube's Terms of Service, and the video is then on YouTube under YouTube's terms. Deleting your Director account doesn't remove it from YouTube: do that on YouTube. You can withdraw Director's access to your Google Account at any time.

privacyDoc.intro:
Director helps you film your own version of a YouTube Short, with Gemini directing you through your camera. To do that it handles your camera, your microphone and the videos you make, so this page sets out what Director collects, where it goes, how long it's kept and how to delete it. It describes Director as it runs today, a demo: read the notice above before you use it.

Director is made and run by Manas Madan ("we" and "us" on this page). Questions go to manasmadan08@gmail.com.

summary.title: The short version
summary.body:
• Director is an experimental demo: anything you put in it may be lost or deleted at any time.
  • Director uses your camera and microphone only on the shoot screen, once you've allowed them in your browser.
  • While you shoot, what your camera sees and what you say go to Gemini on Google Cloud's Vertex AI, so Director can talk you through each shot. Under Google Cloud's terms, Google doesn't use it to train its AI models.
  • Director records the whole time you're shooting, your chat with Director included, until you tap Done. You can pause at any time. That raw recording is deleted automatically after 7 days, or at most 14 if you saved a video from it.
  • Your takes and saved videos stay in your account until you delete your account, unless they're lost or deleted sooner.
  • Nothing goes to YouTube unless you tap to post it, and Director asks for permission to upload only when you first do.
  • Director has no ads or advertising trackers, and doesn't sell your data.
  • You can delete your account, and everything in it, from Settings.

account.title: Your account
account.body:
To make an account you either sign in with Google or sign up with your email address and a password.

  • With Google, Google gives us your name, email address and profile picture. At sign-in Director asks Google for your basic profile only.
  • With an email address, we keep your name, your email address and your password, stored only as a one-way hash that can't be turned back into it. We email you a code to check the address is yours. When you choose a password, Director checks it against passwords leaked in public data breaches through the Have I Been Pwned service, which receives only the first few characters of the password's hash, never the password.

We also keep the language and time zone your browser reports, so emails and dates read right; a profile picture, if you upload one (we remove its location and camera details); and what you set up to protect your account: passkeys (only their public half) and two-step verification (its secret and backup codes, encrypted).

Each time you sign in we keep a record of that session, with your IP address and your browser's name, so you can see your signed-in devices in Settings and sign them out. A session ends about 7 days after you last used it.

We email you only about your account: sign-in and verification codes, password resets, and alerts when something about your account's security changes.

demo.title: Trying the demo
demo.body:
"Try it now" signs your browser in as a guest: a private account of its own, with a made-up address that can't receive email. Nobody else sees what a guest films. A guest, and everything made in it (its recordings, takes and videos), is deleted 24 hours after it was created. A guest can't post to YouTube or change its account.

If no guest can be made at that moment, the sign-in page offers a shared demo account instead. Everyone who uses the shared account can see what's filmed in it, so don't film anything there you wouldn't want strangers to see. Its takes and videos are deleted a day after they're made.

shoot.title: When you shoot
shoot.body:
Director uses your camera and microphone only on the shoot screen, and only once you've allowed them in your browser. This is what happens to them.

  • Talking with Director. While you shoot, your microphone's audio and about one picture a second from your camera go through our server to Gemini Live on Google Cloud's Vertex AI, in Google's us-central1 region in the United States, and Director's voice comes back. Gemini writes down what you both say, so your browser can show it as captions. We don't keep a written log of the conversation: what you say is in the recording described next. A call with Director lasts at most 30 minutes.
  • Recording. From Start shooting until you tap Done, your browser records your camera and microphone, your chat with Director included, in ten-second pieces, and uploads each one straight to our Google Cloud Storage. Pieces still waiting to upload are kept in your browser's storage on your device until they're sent. Pause stops the recording, and Director can't see or hear you while it's paused. One shoot records at most 20 minutes.
  • Takes. Each attempt at a shot is cut out of the recording as a take, on a private Google Cloud Run service. A few minutes after you tap Done, Gemini watches the whole recording once, to find good moments the live marks missed. Gemini also reviews every take: a score, a line of feedback, a description of what's in it and a transcript of what's said, kept with the take so you can find it in the editor.
  • Showing Director something. When you ask Director to find something in view, the camera's current picture goes to Gemini to find it.
  • When Director can't go live. If Gemini Live isn't available, you can type to Director, or talk through your browser's own speech recognition. That recognition belongs to your browser, so its maker (Google for Chrome, Apple for Safari) may process that audio under its own policy. What you type or say then goes to Gemini as text, and Director's replies are spoken by Gemini's text-to-speech.

content.title: What you make
content.body:
• Templates. When you paste a link to a YouTube Short, Gemini watches it on YouTube and writes a shot-by-shot plan, which we keep with a copy of the Short's original audio so you can film along to it. Each account can index one Short of its own.
  • Templates you describe. If you describe an idea of your own instead, we keep what you typed, your answers to Director and any photos you add, and send them to Gemini to plan it.
  • Your version. As you talk with Director, it keeps a version of the template that's yours: notes of a few words about what you told it (where you're filming, who's in it, what you'd rather not do), and the shots it changed, skipped or left for the editor to fill.
  • Takes and videos. Every take, with its review, and every video you save from the editor. Videos are put together in your browser, then uploaded.
  • Photos and pictures. Photos you upload are checked for viruses on our own server and stored with your account. Pictures and short clips Director makes for you with Google's image and Veo video models are stored too, with the words they were made from.
  • Likes and saves of Shorts in the library.

We also count how much of its monthly AI allowance each account uses.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.body:
Director uses YouTube API Services. Shorts play in YouTube's own player, from its privacy-enhanced domain (youtube-nocookie.com), and Director reads Shorts' public details, such as their title and channel, from YouTube's API. Google's use of that information is covered by the Google Privacy Policy.

Posting a video is up to you. The first time you post, Director asks Google for permission to upload videos to your YouTube channel, and for nothing more. We keep the access Google gives us, encrypted, and use it only when you tap to post, after you've checked the title, description and visibility (unlisted unless you change it). Once posted, the video is on YouTube under YouTube's terms, and deleting your Director account doesn't remove it from YouTube. You can withdraw Director's access at any time in your Google Account's security settings.

analytics.title: Analytics and logs
analytics.body:
• Product analytics. To understand how Director is used, we record events such as a call started, a take reviewed, or a video saved or posted, in Google BigQuery. An event holds ids (yours, the template's and the Short's), the time, counts, scores and timings, such as how long Director took to answer. It never holds your name, your email address, your footage, or the words you or Director said.
  • Server logs. Our servers log what happens on them, to keep Director running and secure: who did what (your account id, name and email address), your IP address and your browser.
  • Security log. A record of security events on accounts (account created, signed in and out, password and two-step changes, account deleted), with ids rather than content.

How long each is kept is in "How long it's kept" below.

sharing.title: Who else handles your data
sharing.body:
We don't sell your data or share it for advertising. These services handle it for us, only to run Director:

  • Google Cloud: the server Director runs on and its database; Cloud Storage for recordings, takes, videos and photos; Vertex AI's Gemini, Gemini Live, image, Veo and text-to-speech models; Cloud Run, for cutting takes and indexing Shorts; and BigQuery, for analytics.
  • Cloudflare: Director's domain and the network in front of the site, which every visit passes through, and Turnstile, which checks that a sign-in comes from a person.
  • Resend: delivers Director's emails.
  • YouTube (Google): plays Shorts, provides their public details, and receives the videos you choose to post.
  • Have I Been Pwned: checks new passwords against known breaches, as described above.
  • Pexels and Pixabay: when stock photo search is available, the words you search for go to them.

We may also disclose information when the law requires it, or to protect Director, its members or others from harm.

location.title: Where your data is
location.body: Director runs on Google Cloud in the United States. Its server, its database and its Cloud Storage bucket are in the us-central1 region (Iowa), and so is Gemini Live. Product analytics are in BigQuery's US multi-region, which Google may serve from any of its locations in the United States. Director's other Gemini requests go through Vertex AI's global endpoint, which Google may serve from any of its locations. If you live outside the United States, your data is transferred there.

retention.title: How long it's kept
retention.body:
These are the deletion schedules Director is set up with. As a demo, it may also lose or delete anything sooner.

  • Raw recordings (everything recorded while you shoot): deleted 7 days after they're recorded. Saving a video from one keeps it for 7 days from that save, but never more than 14 days after it was recorded. Cloud Storage also deletes any raw recording still there 15 days after it was uploaded.
  • Demo guests: deleted with everything in them 24 hours after they're made. The shared demo account's takes and videos: after a day.
  • Takes, reviews, saved videos, photos, templates and your versions: until you delete your account.
  • Director's spoken lines (audio of Director's voice, kept so the same line isn't made twice): Cloud Storage deletes them 90 days after they're made.
  • Signed-in sessions: about 7 days after you last use them.
  • Server logs: 30 days.
  • Records of the emails we send you: 90 days.
  • Security log: 13 months.
  • Database backups: 14 days, so something deleted can stay in a backup for up to 14 days more.
  • Analytics events: these hold no name, email address or content, and have no set expiry.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.body:
• Delete your account in Settings, under Security. It asks for your password: if you signed up with Google and never set one, use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page to set one first. Deleting your account deletes everything in it: templates, recordings, takes, videos, photos and your versions. Their files are usually gone from storage within the hour, apart from the backups, logs and analytics described above.
  • Keep a copy. You can download each video when you save it. Director has no export of everything else.
  • Correct it. Change your name, email address, language, time zone and profile picture in Settings.
  • Withdraw YouTube access in your Google Account at any time, as described above.
  • Turn off the camera or microphone in your browser whenever you like. Director can't use them without your permission.

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR in the European Union and the UK, or in California), the law may give you further rights over your data, such as to access, correct, delete or move it, to object to or restrict how it's used, and to complain to your data protection authority. You can send any request to manasmadan08@gmail.com; we may consider it at our discretion, as far as the law allows.

Director uses your data to provide the demo to you under its terms; for logs, security and analytics, to keep the demo running and learn from it; and for your camera and microphone, with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time by stopping.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage on your device
cookies.body: Director uses only the cookies it needs: one that keeps you signed in, ones that remember your language and time zone, and, if you ask, one that remembers a device you trust for two-step verification. Cloudflare's Turnstile may set its own when it checks a sign-in. Director also keeps a little in your browser's storage: footage waiting to upload, your light or dark theme, and how many shoots you've started, so the shoot screen explains itself only the first time. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

security.title: Security
security.body: Connections to Director are encrypted. Passwords are hashed, and Google access tokens and two-step backup codes are encrypted in the database. The database itself keeps each account's data apart from every other's. Recordings, videos and photos are stored privately and reached only through links that expire soon after they're made. Takes are cut on a separate service with no access to the database or secrets. None of this makes Director secure: it's a demo, and no system is perfectly secure.

children.title: Children
children.body: Director isn't meant for anyone under 13. If you think a child has an account, email us; we may delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: This policy may change at any time, without notice, as Director does. The date at the top shows the latest version.

errors.FILE_NOT_READY: That file is still being checked. Try again in a moment.

errors.DIRECTOR_ASSET_NOT_FOUND: That picture isn't here any more. Pick another.

errors.DIRECTOR_PLAN_NOT_EDITABLE: Only the person who described this one can change its shots.
errors.DIRECTOR_VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: That video isn't on YouTube, or it's private. Check the link and try again.

errors.RECORDING_NOT_FOUND: That recording isn't here any more. Its footage may have been deleted.

errors.RECORDING_PART_NOT_FOUND: That part of the recording isn't here. Reopen the shoot to carry on.

errors.RECORDING_SLICE_NOT_UPLOADED: Some footage didn't finish uploading. It'll be sent again.
errors.RECORDING_ATTEMPT_NOT_OPEN: There's no attempt going on to finish.
errors.RECORDING_MARK_OUT_OF_ORDER: Director lost track of this attempt. Reopen the shoot to carry on.
errors.RECORDING_SLICE_INVALID: Part of the recording couldn't be read, so it wasn't kept.

errors.DIRECTOR_CREATE_FAILED: Director couldn't write your shots this time. Try describing it again.
errors.DIRECTOR_REVIEW_FAILED: Director couldn't review this take. Record it again.
errors.RECORDING_CLIP_FAILED: Director couldn't cut this attempt out of your footage. Try the shot again.
errors.TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That's too much data to send at once.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: That kind of content isn't accepted here.

progress.hint: This usually takes one to three minutes.

shoot.cameraBlocked: Director needs your camera. Allow it in your browser's settings, then try again.
shoot.cameraMissing: There's no camera Director can use on this device.

intro.title: Let's shoot this together
intro.first: Director sees your camera and hears you while you get set, and talks you through each shot. A take records only when you tap the shutter. Your browser asks for the camera and microphone next.
intro.again: Director sees and hears you while you get set. A take records only when you tap the shutter.
intro.rollFirst: Director records the whole time you're shooting, chat included, so it can find your best moments. Only the clips you use go in your video. Pause any time. Your browser asks for the camera and microphone next.
intro.rollAgain: Director records the whole time you're shooting, chat included. Only the clips you use go in your video. Pause any time.
intro.sharedDemo: On the shared demo account, Director doesn't record the whole shoot, since everyone trying Director uses it. Sign up to have it record everything and find your best moments.

leaving.title: Leave?
leaving.rollBody: Leaving ends this shoot. What's recorded so far is kept, and your takes wait for you in the editor.

shoot.original: The original's audio plays while you film.
shoot.recordFailed: Director couldn't start the camera's recording here. Try again, or another browser.
